name: Engineering
desc: Higher engineering skill allows you to learn higher level engineering schematics.  Schematics can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.

ranks.name: Apprentice
ranks.desc: Allows an engineer to make basic contraptions up to a maximum potential skill of 75. Requires stone and metal found with the mining skill.

ranks.name: Journeyman
ranks.desc: Allows an engineer to make more powerful devices and explosives up to a maximum potential skill of 150.

ranks.name: Expert
ranks.desc: Allows an engineer to make bombs and gizmos that are a wonder to behold up to a maximum potential skill of 225.

ranks.name: Artisan
ranks.desc: Allows an engineer to make bombs and gizmos that are truly amazing up to a maximum potential skill of 300.

specs.name: Goblin Engineer
specs.desc: Allows an engineer to make lethal goblin devices.

specs.name: Gnomish Engineer
specs.desc: Allows an engineer to make fantastic, yet unreliable gnomish devices.

specs.name: Mechanical Dragonling
specs.desc: Activates your Mechanical Dragonling to fight for you for 1 min.

specs.name: Mithril Mechanical Dragonling
specs.desc: Activates your Mithril Mechanical Dragonling to fight for you for 1 min. It requires an hour to cool down before it can be used again.

specs.name: Arcanite Dragonling
specs.desc: Activates your Arcanite Dragonling to fight for you for 1 min.

specs.name: Battle Chicken
specs.desc: Creates a Battle Chicken that will fight for you for 90 sec or until it is destroyed.

specs.name: Summon Goblin Bomb
specs.desc: Creates a mobile bomb that charges the nearest enemy and explodes for 350 fire damage.

recipes.name: Tinker: Magnetic Displacement
recipes.desc:
Augment your belt to give the following effect:

Disrupt a magnetic field between you and your nearby enemy target, knocking you both away.

Can only affect targets up to 2 levels higher than you. Some targets cannot be displaced. Targets can only be affected by this effect once every 2 min.

recipes.name: Tinker: Nitro Boosts
recipes.desc:
Augment your belt to give the following effect:

Activate a set of jets to increase your movement speed by up to 140%, for up to 8 sec.

recipes.name: Tinker: Teleport
recipes.desc:
Augment your belt to give the following effect:

Teleport forward 20 yds.
